summary: The maintained PR updater has a separately explicit --adopt-legacy-pr mode for an existing routine PR whose lane-admission metadata is genuinely absent. Default update still refuses absent identity; malformed, duplicate or conflicting identities always refuse. Adoption preserves the existing routine operation and unknown machine metadata, checks the exact already pushed native head and existing previous/current routine marker, reconciles complete paginated native open population twice, refuses competing chains/unknown managed reservations/third managed PR, compares deciding native metadata, sends at most one PATCH and independently reads it back. Changed population or uncertainty fences the original effect; no automatic replay, competing PR, silent identity replacement or source-to-live acceptance follows. A matching already adopted identity follows ordinary update semantics. Source support and maintained fake-API tests do not establish actual native adoption, exact-head requiredCI, source delivery or whole Delivery acceptance. Existing Rendering1448/PR1447 is the concrete integration consumer; retain its original no-write refusal and full source/runtime acceptance.
title: Explicit legacy routine PR adoption retains metadata and population barriers
